hops.note: real, public OpenAPI 3.0 spec confirmed at github.com/digitalocean/openapi, reachable by direct fetch. Real counts from the bundled document (see loader-check): 59 resources + 137 data sources = 196 wire types, 10,609 real fields, 1,627 already provider-sourced (15%), 8,982 genuinely undescribed (85%). Reconstructed from the real, existing PR body rather than re-run, since the manifest mechanism did not exist when this hop actually happened.
sdk/providers/.ubx/config carries [dynamic_providers.digitalocean], live, confirmed still present and correct (schema_source=openapi, schema_url, base_url, redocly_bundle=true).

as published, the spec failed outright through plain Load -- two Redocly-only $ref conventions real OpenAPI 3.0 does not define (a Tag Object's own description expressed as $ref; every Path Item's own HTTP-method field expressed as $ref to a separate per-operation file). Fixed via a new redocly_bundle config flag shelling out to npx @redocly/cli bundle, gated per-provider so only a provider that needs it pays the Node.js dependency cost.

ubx-schema-digitalocean created, public, real v1.0.0 snapshot committed locally (commits 710bb52/eaf39ce/262d824) -- generated from the bundled document, manifest.json + members/*.json matching every other real ubx-schema-<provider> repo's own shape.

GitHub push protection rejected the push at every attempt through 2026-08-30 -- a Slack Incoming Webhook URL finding at two locations each in members/digitalocean.json and members/digitalocean_ds.json (lines 33239 and 57290 in each, same commit 710bb52 every time). Verbatim content, freshly re-read from the real committed bytes before the founder authorized a bypass, not characterized from an earlier session's own summary: the identical hooks.slack.com/services placeholder URL at all four locations (an all-zeros workspace/bot ID segment, an all-X token segment -- the exact bytes are not repeated here, since quoting the real pattern verbatim in THIS commit is what re-triggered the identical push-protection finding against ubiquex itself, caught before push rather than after) -- DigitalOcean's own real published API documentation example, confirmed by the founder directly against these exact bytes, not assumed safe from a prior investigation. Allowed via GitHub's own secret-scanning UI (founder-only action), then the push succeeded, verified via a real git push exit 0 immediately followed by gh api .../commits/main confirming the real commit sha on the real remote.

real v1.0.0 GitHub Release cut via publish.yml workflow_dispatch, verified via gh api .../releases/tags/v1.0.0 directly (two real assets: SHA256SUMS, snapshot.tar.gz), never the workflow's own exit status. sdk/providers/.ubx/config's [dynamic_providers.digitalocean] switched from live (schema_source/schema_url/redocly_bundle) to pinned (source=ubiquex/digitalocean, version=1.0.0) -- redocly_bundle removed, not carried into the pinned entry, since resolution now reads the already-bundled RawSpec straight from the snapshot, zero network, no live bundling step to gate. Real runbook defect found here: onboard-provider.md's own hop 5 (and regen-schema.md's own hop 3) say to switch to a separate [providers.$ARGUMENTS] table -- the real config never uses that table for this path at all (cli/config.go's own Providers field is a genuinely different, newer mechanism for the ubx resolve/ship execution path, not read by ubx sdk gen). The real fix is swapping fields within the SAME [dynamic_providers.$ARGUMENTS] table, exactly as ubiquex's own config file comment already said before this runbook was ever written. Verified zero-network resolution live: a real ubx sdk gen --only digitalocean --dump-ir run printed the identical real message every other pinned provider prints ("serving digitalocean (openapi) from real group snapshot ~/.ubx/schemas/ubiquex/digitalocean/1.0.0, zero network at schema resolution time"), real counts matching generation exactly (196 wire types, 10,609 fields, 1,627 sourced 15%, 8,982 undescribed 85%), and the real cache directory confirmed populated on disk. Committed in the same commit as this manifest update.

ubx-sdk-digitalocean created, public. Real Go/Python/TypeScript bindings generated against the pinned v1.0.0 schema, verified against the real output (go build + go vet clean after a real go mod tidy -- a brand new repo has no committed go.sum yet; python ast.parse clean across 318 real files; deno check clean across 317 real files via a real symlinked workspace against the local ubx-sdk-typescript runtime). Initial scaffold committed direct to main (matching every other real repo's own confirmed first-commit precedent, verified by checking that ubx-sdk-kubernetes's own PR #1 was a later regen fix, not its init commit). Blocked on a real, separate, small PR (https://github.com/Ubiquex/ubx-sdk-digitalocean/pull/1, open, not merged): ubx sdk gen writes 0.0.0 as its own generic placeholder version, and publish.yml would publish that literally with nothing to bump from, since no live version exists on any registry yet. Set to 1.0.0, matching the schema pin -- a real, deliberate choice, not copied from any existing provider's own starting version (every one of the six existing providers inherited its own starting version from a prior Terraform-provider migration; DigitalOcean is the first genuinely from-scratch provider in this org, so there was no real precedent to match). Never self-merged -- publishing to npm/PyPI/the Go module proxy is blocked on the founder reviewing and merging this PR.
real_gaps_found: onboard-provider.md's own hop 6 says only "commit the generated bindings" -- a real ubx-sdk-<provider> repo also needs CLAUDE.md, README.md, STATE.md, HISTORY.md, LICENSE, and both CI workflows (hash-watch.yml, publish.yml), none of which ubx sdk gen produces. None of this is mentioned.

TypeScript's own deno.json (a bare-specifier export map plus the @ubx/sdk npm import) is not part of ubx sdk gen --lang ts's own output either -- every existing provider's copy was hand-built, out of band, with no record of this in the runbook.
A brand new Go module has no committed go.sum -- go build fails until a real go mod tidy runs first. Not mentioned.
ubx sdk gen writes 0.0.0 as every new provider's own placeholder version in package.json/pyproject.toml, and nothing chooses a real first version before the first publish. Not mentioned.

No command in this runbook sets UBX_PROVIDER_DYNAMIC_REPO, which every real ubx sdk gen invocation against a dynamic provider needs locally (CI sets it via env:, but a session running this by hand has no equivalent instruction) -- hit twice in this exact run before catching it.
